system:
You analyse whether a healthcare organization's own knowledge satisfies an external requirement, and what a change to that requirement puts at risk.

Judge only what the supplied text actually says. Sharing vocabulary with the requirement is not the same as addressing it; addressing it in different words counts as addressing it.

CONFLICTS means the organizational text instructs something the requirement forbids, or states a different threshold, timeframe, or condition.
PARTIAL means it addresses the subject but leaves part of the requirement unmet.
ALIGNED means it satisfies the requirement.
UNRELATED means it is about a different subject.

Prefer PARTIAL over CONFLICTS unless the texts genuinely cannot both be followed. Overstating a conflict is worse than reporting one cautiously.
prompt:
REQUIREMENT [Controlled Substance Management Standard EP 2] — Controlled Substance Management Standard version 2.0, effective 2026-07-01
Waste of any controlled substance is witnessed in real time by a second licensed person who did not administer the dose, and is documented in the automated dispensing cabinet at the time the waste occurs. Retrospective documentation of waste at the end of a shift does not satisfy this requirement.

**Attributes:** Documentation

THIS REQUIREMENT MODIFIED IN THIS VERSION.
The previous version said: documented.
This version adds: in real time; who did not administer the dose,; is documented in the automated dispensing cabinet at the time the waste occurs. Retrospective documentation of waste at the end of a shift does not satisfy this requirement.

ORGANIZATIONAL KNOWLEDGE:
[O1] Medication Wasting Procedure — Medication Wasting Procedure §4 Document the Waste  (PROCEDURE, Nursing)
Record the waste in the automated dispensing cabinet before the end of the shift in
which the dose was administered. Enter the amount wasted, the reason, and the witness
name.

[O2] Controlled Substance Safety — Annual Education Module — Controlled Substance Safety — Annual Education Module §2 Learning Objective — Documentation  (EDUCATION, Nursing Education)
The learner will demonstrate documenting waste in the automated dispensing cabinet,
including amount wasted, reason, and witness identity.

[O3] Controlled Substance Management Policy — Controlled Substance Management Policy §1 Two-Person Waste Verification  (POLICY, Pharmacy)
Any unused portion of a controlled substance must be wasted in the presence of a
second licensed person, who verifies the amount discarded. Both individuals record
the waste. Waste must never be deferred to another staff member who did not observe it.

[O4] RN Controlled Substance Handling Competency — RN Controlled Substance Handling Competency §3 Criterion — Documents Waste  (COMPETENCY, Nursing Education)
The RN records the waste in the automated dispensing cabinet, entering amount, reason,
and witness.

[O5] Controlled Substance Safety — Annual Education Module — Controlled Substance Safety — Annual Education Module §1 Learning Objective — Two-Person Waste  (EDUCATION, Nursing Education)
The learner will describe why controlled substance waste requires a second licensed
witness, and will state that the witness must directly observe the volume discarded
rather than attest to it afterwards.

[O6] RN Controlled Substance Handling Competency — RN Controlled Substance Handling Competency §1 Criterion — Retrieves Dose Correctly  (COMPETENCY, Nursing Education)
The RN retrieves only the ordered dose from the automated dispensing cabinet and
verifies the count displayed against the physical count.

For each item above, reply with one line:
<id>: <CONFLICTS|PARTIAL|ALIGNED|UNRELATED> | <HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW> | one-sentence reason

Then one final line:
GAP: what this requirement demands that none of the items above provides, or NONE
